observations: 2014 BMC Plant Biology study of pPLAIIIδ effects on auxin-responsive morphology and organ size in Arabidopsis and Brassica napus; DOI:10.1186/s12870-014-0332-1.

entities.name: pPLAIIIδ
observations: Overexpression inhibited longitudinal growth and promoted transverse growth in most organs of Arabidopsis and Brassica napus; knockout enhanced hypocotyl cell elongation in Arabidopsis.

entities.name: pPLAIIIδ auxin morphology
observations: In Arabidopsis and Brassica napus, altered pPLAIIIδ expression changed organ growth direction and cell morphology; expression perturbation altered endogenous auxin distribution and IAA responsiveness. OE lines showed increased auxin-induced gene expression under reported treatments.
